flags.water-sewer: Whether the parcel has adequate water and sewer service is currently unknown and unverified, so this should be checked directly with PWSA [utilities.water_sewer].This detail is never included in the scoring, so it does not affect the score shown [utilities.water_sewer].
flags.adu: A proposed rule (not yet law) would allow up to 2 accessory dwelling units by right on this R1A-VH zoned parcel, with size and height limits and no owner-occupancy requirement [zoning.district, reform.status].This proposal is still 'Held In Council' with a hearing scheduled, so it cannot be relied on yet [reform.status].
flags.parking-minimum: Another proposed rule would remove minimum off-street parking requirements, which could free up land and money for more housing, but this is not law yet [reform.status].
flags.affordable-housing-bonus: A proposed optional Affordable Housing Bonus could apply here since the parcel is outside the Inclusionary Housing Overlay, but again this rule is only proposed and not law [overlay.iz, reform.status].
flags.gap-financing: This parcel is in a neighborhood with low median land value per square foot, so gap financing (extra funding to cover costs) may likely be needed; this is just a note, not a penalty on the score [hood.median_land_psf].
flags.phfa-infill: Because this is a vacant lot in a low-value area, it may qualify for infill or blight-related scoring under PHFA (Pennsylvania Housing Finance Agency) programs, but this should be confirmed against current PHFA criteria [landuse.vacant, hood.median_land_psf].
flags.public-owner: The parcel is owned by the City, which may make it easier (though not guaranteed) to acquire through the City's public property-disposition process [owner.type].
